scope: exact token overlap between evaluation prompts and the three packed training windows consumed by the Paper 1 proxy

training.boundary_rule: scan within each 4096-token training sequence only; never fabricate adjacency across examples or microbatches

tokenizer.parity_rule: first case in every task/length cell must match the pinned Transformers tokenizer; reject literal special-token strings in every prompt

probes.answer_anchored: one centered 32-token window for every expected-answer occurrence in its prompt
probes.full_prompt: every prompt no longer than one 4096-token training sequence
probes.deduplication: identical token probes share one scan key while retaining their reference count

decision.context_probe_matches: descriptive source-overlap risk; no post-hoc pass threshold
decision.failure_action: a full-prompt or answer-anchored match blocks absolute benchmark claims and requires case regeneration or explicit contaminated analysis
decision.paired_scope: shared contamination cannot establish absolute capability but is common to paired architectures trained on identical windows

required: unique and referenced probe counts by kind, task, and length
match counts by training window and source
non_claims: zero sampled context-probe matches does not prove absence of contamination
token overlap does not prove training-example provenance
shared overlap does not validate absolute benchmark capability
this protocol does not scan training data outside the exact proxy windows
